meta.rationale: Your apps are planets turning slowly round a warm sun; reach out and pick the one you want.
meta.theme-about: orrery: a full-screen animated canvas of a solar system seen from slightly above, each app a planet on its own tilted elliptical orbit (sizes and colours differ, some with rings or moons), the planet under the pointer glows and shows its name, click a planet to open it; a brass-and-ink almanac panel in the top-left with the date and time. Astronomical, slow, wondrous. (#sky, #almanac, #index)

desktop.canvas: local COL = {"#c9774a", "#e0c27a", "#6f86d6", "#d65a4a", "#d9b57a", "#9fd6c8", "#a78bd6", "#7ab05a"} local hits, hot = {}, nil function draw(w, h, t) local cx, cy = w * 0.56, h * 0.54 local px, py, over = g.pointer() g.glow(cx, cy, 170, "rgba(255,190,90,0.35)") local apps = g.apps() local bodies = {} for i, a in ipairs(apps) do if i > 8 then break end local rx = 110 + i * 68 local ry = rx * 0.36 g.arc(cx, cy, 1, 0, 0, "#000000", 0) local seg, prevx, prevy = 64, nil, nil for k = 0, seg do local an = k / seg * math.pi * 2 local x, y = cx + math.cos(an) * rx, cy + math.sin(an) * ry if prevx then g.line(prevx, prevy, x, y, "rgba(201,178,122,0.22)", 1) end prevx, prevy = x, y end local sp = 0.5 / (1 + i * 0.6) local an = t * sp + i * 1.9 local x, y = cx + math.cos(an) * rx, cy + math.sin(an) * ry local r = 9 + (i * 37 % 11) + (i == 5 and 10 or 0) bodies[#bodies + 1] = {x = x, y = y, r = r, c = COL[(i - 1) % #COL + 1], name = a.name, id = a.id, i = i, behind = math.sin(an) < 0} end table.sort(bodies, function(a, b) return a.y < b.y end) local sunDrawn = false hot = nil for _, b in ipairs(bodies) do if over and (px - b.x) ^ 2 + (py - b.y) ^ 2 < (b.r + 10) ^ 2 then hot = b.id end end for _, b in ipairs(bodies) do if not sunDrawn and b.y > cy then g.circle(cx, cy, 46, "#ffcf6a") g.circle(cx - 8, cy - 8, 30, "#ffe6a8") sunDrawn = true end if b.id == hot then g.glow(b.x, b.y, b.r * 3.2, "rgba(255,230,160,0.45)") end g.circle(b.x, b.y, b.r, b.c) g.circle(b.x - b.r * 0.3, b.y - b.r * 0.3, b.r * 0.55, "rgba(255,255,255,0.22)") if b.i == 5 or b.i == 7 then g.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r * 1.7, 3.3, 6.1, "rgba(240,225,190,0.7)", 2) end if b.i % 3 == 0 then local ma = t * 1.3 + b.i g.circle(b.x + math.cos(ma) * (b.r + 9), b.y + math.sin(ma) * (b.r + 6) * 0.5, 3, "#d8d0c0") end g.text(b.x + b.r + 8, b.y - 9, b.name, b.id == hot and "#ffe6a8" or "rgba(242,230,201,0.75)", b.id == hot and 16 or 13, "Lora") end if not sunDrawn then g.circle(cx, cy, 46, "#ffcf6a") g.circle(cx - 8, cy - 8, 30, "#ffe6a8") end hits = bodies end function click(x, y) for _, b in ipairs(hits) do if (x - b.x) ^ 2 + (y - b.y) ^ 2 < (b.r + 10) ^ 2 then return "open:" .. b.id end end end
